1) Proration math: capacity increase effective 2026-10-20 — invoiced period 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-31 (12 days) out of October (31 days). Additional seats: 50.
   - Unit price per seat (monthly): $150.
   - Prorated amount = 50 seats * $150 * (12/31) = $29,032.26 (rounded).
2) Storage addon: flat $600/month, prorated same way => $600 * (12/31) = $232.26.
3) VAT: customer provided GB VAT ID. For UK-registered entities the invoice should indicate reverse-charge and show VAT ID; do NOT apply UK VAT on line. Finance to include VAT line: "VAT (reverse-charge) — 0.00" and display the VAT ID.
4) Invoice structure requested: two charge lines (capacity prorate, storage prorate), separate GL codes.
5) Payment terms: customer requested due date 2026-11-30. We should set Net 30 but override due date to 2026-11-30 to match their AP cycle (note in memo why due date was overridden).

Marissa: please generate final invoice using PO CL-1199, attach the proration_breakdown.csv, and route to Billing with a request to set due date to 2026-11-30 and mark tax treatment as reverse-charge with VAT ID GB123456789. Marcus, cc BillingOps in case we need immediate ledger entries.
